identity.name: Unusual SSH Activity via Automated Login and Command Execution
identity.summary: An attacker uses SSH to log into a Linux host and executes a malicious script that connects to a C2 server. Cortex detects this behavior as unusual SSH activity based on process start and network conn
identity.description: An attacker uses SSH to log into a Linux host and executes a malicious script that connects to a C2 server. Cortex detects this behavior as unusual SSH activity based on process start and network connection telemetry.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: SSH Client Process Start
biocs.description: Detection of SSH client process execution from non-standard location
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name contains '/tmp/.ssh/' and actor_process_image_name = 'sshd'

abiocs.name: Unusual SSH Activity Pattern
abiocs.description: SSH client process launched from temporary directory after SSH login
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name contains '/tmp/.ssh/' and actor_process_image_name = 'sshd'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'sshd'
abiocs.causality_anchor: sshd process initiating execution of non-standard SSH client binary

xql_queries.name: SSH Client Started from Temp Directory
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name contains '/tmp/.ssh/' and actor_process_image_name = 'sshd'
| fields agent_hostname, action_process_image_name, causality_actor_process_image_name
